notes: Open, semi-locked and locked shows. Once a show's match is sure, AniBox saves its info (title in the library's language, description, genres, studio, year, poster, episode titles). New info found later is put aside for Library → Review info, where you keep or take each field. Info files for Plex now only go to semi-locked shows: after your review (default) or, per library, as soon as the match is certain (Settings → Libraries to show). Locked shows, and whole libraries you lock there, get nothing written. "Check for new info" on each show's page. Note: with the default, Write and fill-in-after-scan only write shows you checked.
